other_conditions: Applicant must be an individual artist or a troupe consisting of more than three artists
Journey must be undertaken by train
Purpose of the journey must be to deliver a cultural performance (public programme) in the outstation
Travel distance must exceed 300 km as fixed by Indian Railways
benefits_summary: 75% concession in Second Class Fare and 50% concession in First Class Fare.
documents_required: copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attested, if required)
